Implemented: mapsDir config key (absolute or relative) moves per-commit maps out of <stateDir>/maps; mapDir/mapPath/loadMap/saveMap, nearestMapCommit, build/select/collect/gc and the schema pass it through. Core 322 and CLI 60 tests pass.

Implemented: select --patch <file.diff> and --change <path>:<start>[-<end>] answer from explicit changes without touching the tree; the patch uses the same parser as --since. Usage errors exit 2. CLI tests cover both and the exclusivity rule.

Implemented: reaches --batch <rows.json> accepts neutral {file, lines|find, killers?} rows, answers the tests that reach each range and whether each killer is among them, and flags an unknown file. Core reachesRows API plus CLI tests.
Implemented: select --since unions the named base diff with the map-commit diff in one answer, merging changes by path with hunk coalescing; mergeChanges is exported and unit-tested.

Implemented: status and duration are kept on map test entries, SelectResult.estimate reports the subset and whole-map recorded milliseconds, and the text summary prints it. Ordering by impact was not implemented because adapters filter by identifier and do not reorder; noted in the docs.
Implemented: select --format summary prints mode, selected of total, reason counts, warnings, ignored and map age in a few lines; other commands reject it.
Implemented: cbd --version --format json carries adapterContract and a capabilities list, answered by the bin before importing the CLI so a broken install still reports.
Implemented: select --emit-selection <path> writes the shared v2 selection file with ids; an all or empty answer removes a stale file rather than leaving a filter that would narrow a full run.

Implemented conservatively: build --incremental (and collect --incremental) carries a base map's tests forward only when every file they touched, read or listed is unchanged; a test that used a changed file is re-recorded or its evidence is dropped and every file it used is marked partial, where any change forces mode: all. Buckets and per-shard load attribution are not carried, so a module-scope change in a load-reached file escalates. Unit-tested carryMap and a CLI end-to-end incremental build.

All roadmap items addressed: collect messages, per-package changelogs, adapter contract (ids, record API, results, ADR-0017), incremental recording, service-shard merge (already supported), shared maps, what-if selection, batch reaches, single-call --since merge, durations and estimate, summary format, capabilities, emit-selection. Full workspace suite green.
Implemented in the working tree: fs read tracking with reads/dirReads, read reason, adapter wiring and the I5 scenario; limitations documented. Release pending owner approval.
Implemented in the working tree: unknownPolicyFor with first-match all/ignore, visible ignores, stale-glob warning, schema and docs. Release pending owner approval.
All round-2 feedback items are implemented and covered by tests in the working tree; the release is pending owner approval (no push, tag or publish).

Implemented: SelectConfig.order 'impact' and cbd select --order impact order by reason directness with a stable within-rank order; the set is unchanged. Core and CLI tests cover the order and the usage error.

Implemented the open-window guard in cbd-jest and cbd-node-test with incomplete-shard refusal; added Recorder.testAbandon for Jest's announced-then-skipped windows. Unit test for node:test, real concurrent fixtures for Vitest and Jest.

Implemented installProcessTracking in core (child_process spawn/exec/fork wrappers, newest-sink stack, CBD_TRACK_PROCESSES=0 opt-out), wired into japa, mocha, jest, node:test and vitest, with core tests for the opaque note and the opt-out.

Implemented read mapping at build time: sibling .map sources and ScanOptions.projection are applied to reads and dirReads before keepRead, with tests for declaration-map sources, projection rules and the exact-prefix slash. Directories project too.

Implemented scoped import-phase reads: Recorder.specStart, the loadReads shard record, resolve/map attribution (spec-matched or shard-wide fallback), wired into all five adapters, with recorder/map tests and a Vitest e2e that reads a file at module scope.

Implemented --selector-map commit: the harness selects since the base against the commit's oracle map, projecting the diff onto the map's new side (including new-side deletion points and dropping pre-map deletions), and uses the selector map for the miss/new-test classification. The mode is syntax-checked but needs an owner-approved grizzly clone for the full-suite measurement.

Implemented line relocation: Change.hunkEdits pairs each @@ header, relocateRange maps a range only when no edit overlaps it, carryMap carries relocated touched evidence and keeps path-level reads/dirs, and the factory passes the diff's relocator. Unit, carry and end-to-end incremental tests cover the shift and the fallback.

Implemented script-row SHA-256 comparison for mtime-only rebuilds, and fixed collect to build only the shards this run wrote (snapshot before the run; per-file and service shards included). Real grizzly libs:pipeline recording now builds: 360 tests, 253 read entries, 3 dirs; a schema.ts change selects exactly AC29 via read with alwaysSelect removed.

selectLoadObservers unions loadShards/shardTests observers with the read answer and the function index in both the no-touches and deletion paths; an unattributed map still forces all. Three new select tests (read-answered barrel, deleted barrel, deleted load module); core suite 362 green. On the grizzly pipeline map the index.ts-only change now selects 360 (was 7).

A full run that writes no complete shard (import failure, crash, or zero tests) is now recorded as a load-failure step instead of aborting the replay. The oracles are skipped, the selector is still checked against the base map and omitted tests are counted as unverified, and commit mode reports that no commit map exists. The base run stays fatal because there is no map to replay against. Validated on the 8-undo range: base mode completes 8/8 with 1 load failure (step 8 subset 360/360, unverified 0); commit mode completes 8/8 with step 8 reported as no commit map.

mapPaths now rewrites tests[].id with testId(file, title) through the same to() transform as file: saveMap stores it relative to the map root, loadMap resolves it back to absolute, and in-memory ids are unchanged. Maps without an id are left untouched. The portability test asserts the stored id is relative and that an id loaded under a second checkout lands under that checkout. Verified on the real grizzly map: stored id typescript/tests/libs/tests/drain.spec.ts::…, reloaded absolute. Core 364, CLI 64, full workspace green.

select forces all once before the loop when configChanged is set, naming configFile; rule 0's per-file branch now matches only the actual config path and adds its own reason only when the flag was not set. Two tests cover config plus source (one all reason naming the config, a function reason for the source) and a config absent from the change list (the single reason still names it). Core 364, CLI 64, full workspace green.

Node 22 does not call afterEach for a test whose body called t.skip(). The adapter now remembers the open window and closes it as skipped at the next beforeEach (before the concurrency guard) or at the file's after; a non-skipped window still open at after refuses the shard instead of dropping the test. Two unit tests simulate both orderings and the never-closing case; the real node:test e2e passes on Node 22.23.3 and Node 24.18. Package suite 12/12 on both; full workspace gate green.

The instrument now warns on stderr with the socket path or error and says this process records no coverage when the inspector attach, profiler start, socket bind or socket open fails, without taking the host down. A new test spawns a process with a 200-character socket path and asserts the host runs, exits 0, and the warning is present; it fails against the old code. Core 365 green. The collector-side failure-marker follow-up remains named in the bead.

The declared-feed mechanism already existed: an alwaysSelect entry with a when glob and a bare test-file locator selects every test the map knows in that file. Added the regression test for the SQL-migration shape (an added migration outside include selects the declared suite, with reason always) and documented the decision in the README: declared config feeds lead for inputs no recorded process opens; reads at spec load (loadReads) and directory listings (dirReads) remain observed. No code change was needed.

Added cbd flaky, a CLI-only command over the maps gc keeps. It sorts maps by builtAt, compares adjacent pairs, and reports a passed/failed flip only when nothing the test reached in either map and not its own spec file changed between the two commits; skipped outcomes, and tests added or removed between maps, are not compared. The fixture has three commits and three maps: a flip with a README-only change is reported, a flip with a changed source file is not. CLI 71 green. No factory verb was added.

Validated on the real grizzly stores shape: two key-server tests against one lane server started with NODE_OPTIONS=--import <cbd instrument>, CBD_SOCKET_DIR and CBD_SNAPSHOT_MS=0. The map held 93 source files; CreateKeyRing.ts and ReadHash.ts were attributed to one test each, ReadKey.ts to both; zero @between and zero lane-keyed files; select --change named exactly the owning test. The existing 0.0.4 mechanism needs no cbd code change. The remaining lane wiring is grizzly T-29-014 (laneClientEnv forwarding NODE_OPTIONS and CBD_SOCKET_DIR, a short socket directory, the instrument in server.env). iter probe: a suite absent from the map answers all, not nothing; a partially recorded suite can answer a subset, which is the residual risk recorded in the notes. The spike map and shards were moved out of the clone, and its selection results are spike-local.

All six children closed: empty CBD environment values, stats freshness and covered suites, per-suite selection files, declared non-JS feeds (regression test and docs), flaky history, and request-driven cross-process attribution validated on the grizzly stores shape (the remaining lane wiring is grizzly T-29-014). The instrument silent-failure child was fixed and closed separately. Full pnpm -r test gate green; the work is under Unreleased for 0.0.5.

recoverFromSnapshot now returns a matched window even when its coverage and requests are empty: the source absorbs its script rows and acknowledges the take, and only a window with no match and no fallback returns null. Extracted recoverFromSnapshot as a pure helper and added a synthetic-snapshot test; socket-source suite 26 green.

cbd collect --target/--allow-remote resolve and lock-check the target before spawning and pass it as CBD_INSPECT(+_ALLOW_REMOTE); the japa plugin opens inspectorSource for it through the same service-recorder path. Malformed target exits 2, a held target exits 1 as one cbd: line. Core 421, japa 73, cli 82 pass; pnpm -r test green.

readTargetPid retries process.pid within the caller's timeout (10ms gap) instead of refusing on the first empty answer; refusal message names both readings. Regression test spawns --inspect=0 -e setInterval and attaches on the debugger line — fails without the retry, passes with it. Core 422, japa 73, cli 82 pass.

Phase 1 shipped: mocha preload clears CBD_SHARD (regression test fails without it); collect unsets inherited CBD_SELECTION; changes.ts strips git's TAB, splits diff --git on the matching sides, keeps -z whitespace; factory filters by header commit before parsing; --shard requires .ndjson; correlate syncs builtin ESM exports on install and release; socket closes on a failed correlate; select falls back to map.dirty; selection file removed in a finally; gc tolerates vanished entries; snapshot interval clamped. pnpm -r test green (core 429, cli 85, mocha 9, japa 73, all others).

Phase 2 shipped: rescan reports nested generatedMissing with pid prefixes; in-process records missing generated text; Source.lostTakes carries swallowed per-target window losses into health.failedTakes; rescan warns once when it writes a socket off. A latent empty-string sourceMapURL from Node was exposed by the new signal and fixed (instrument omits it, resolve treats it as no map). pnpm -r test green (core 432, cli 85, japa 73, mocha 9, rest green).

Phase 3 shipped: node-test and vitest keep refusing a leftover window but name both causes (throwing hook vs concurrency) instead of accusing the runner; a shared titlePartReadings (core contract, exported from root and adapter) makes node-test and jest admit every reading of a title containing ' > '; vitest honours CBD_SELECTION with no CBD_SHARD; japa closes its recorders in a finally so a rejected drain cannot leave a socket open. pnpm -r test green (core 433, jest 12, node-test 12, vitest 8, japa 73, cli 85).

Phase 4 shipped: mutate excludes <module> from the outside-function check (regression test fails without the filter), and honours partial/unhealthy (mode all) plus opaque/read/dirReads observers (added to every subset, and to a would-be 'none'). New MutantWhy members partial/unhealthy. pnpm -r test green (core 436, mutate 4, rest green).

Phase 5 shipped: hello echoes the correlation header and the collector compares names; recorder runStart resets per-run state; japa lifecycle calls are guarded and sources close in a finally; paths that do not exist yet canonicalize through their nearest ancestor (without existsSync, which re-entered the read tracker); verify warns when nothing matched; generated text is fetched only for scripts whose map travelled; an inherited CBD_INSPECT is preflighted; the snapshot interval is clamped. F15 (probe throttle) was implemented and then reverted: it skipped recovery of windows that could still be recovered, which a six-way stress run exposed. pnpm -r test green.
All five phases shipped; pnpm -r test green. Three follow-ups for the next release are filed under cbd-1vc (dead-child snapshot harvest, service-side read tracking, neighbour policy).
